question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Terse
solution:
The correct answer is **"Polite."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Terse"** means using few words and often seeming rude or unfriendly. (संक्षिप्‍त और रूखा)

 
 
• **Example**: *He gave us a **terse**__ reply.*
 
 
 
• **"Polite"** is the opposite of **"**rude or unfriendly**."**
 
• It means showing good manners and respect for others. (सुशील और दूसरों का सम्‍मान करने वाला; नम्र, शिष्‍ट)
 __
 
• **Example**: *The assistants in that shop are always very helpful and **polite**__.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the antonym of **Terse is Polite**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 2.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1, **Authoritative**, means having or showing authority or power, and is not the opposite of Terse. (अधिकारिक; आदेशात्‍मक, आज्ञासूचक)
 
• Option 3, **Timid**, means showing a lack of courage or confidence, and is not the opposite of Terse. (जल्‍दी डर जाने वाला, भीरु; संकोची और जल्‍दी घबरा जाने वाला)
 
• Option 4, **Excited**, means feeling or showing happiness or enthusiasm, and is not the opposite of Terse. (उत्तेजित, व्‍यग्र; अधीर)
